HongguoWorker isolated GPL service vendor source

media.mjs contains selected and adapted parsing/cryptographic functions from:
N3urda/hongguoTV commit eea73e6a45569a2cbbb9440f7cd5290c459b0b70,
server/vendor/hongguo.cjs, originally woshishiq1/drpys
spider/js/红果果[短].js at 22261adfa31435e3b3ef5a730b8a2a75bcaf1715.
https://github.com/N3urda/hongguoTV/blob/eea73e6a45569a2cbbb9440f7cd5290c459b0b70/server/vendor/hongguo.cjs
https://github.com/woshishiq1/drpys/tree/22261adfa31435e3b3ef5a730b8a2a75bcaf1715
GPL-3.0-only, full licenses retained beside this file.

Changes: static ESM exports, Workers node:crypto/Buffer imports; no VM/FS/axios,
no upstream signing/device constants or rule runtime. Bounded sample indices,
rejection of unsupported subsample encryption/IV formats, binary search into
sample ranges, original protected sample entry codec retained from frma.
Provider HTTP transport is maintained independently. Current upstream requests
use registered anonymous 7.3.9.32 identities and protocol.mjs, not the obsolete
unsigned multi-video transport. Historical unsigned probes are kept only as
failed diagnostic evidence in out/hongguo-cloudflare-2026-11-10.
No portion of this service is linked or copied into the Den App target.

keys.mjs is a portable translation of internal/drm/spade.go from
beilunyang/openhongguo 42b73f201309423f012d483bfc0ce579dcc0937c (2026-11-04).
Copyright retained by the upstream contributors, Apache-2.0 license retained
in LICENSE.openhongguo. Adds wrapper size checks and 128-bit key requirement.

protocol.mjs contains selected signing arithmetic adapted from the same fixed
hongguoTV source above (GPL-3.0-only), with fresh per-installation identity,
injected deterministic entropy, portable SM3, and no upstream shared devices.
Protocol request fields, registration envelope and TTEncrypt are adapted from:
beilunyang/openhongguo commit 42b73f201309423f012d483bfc0ce579dcc0937c
(2026-11-04, v0.2.0), internal/protocol/{app,device,register,request,tt_encrypt}.go,
sdk/model/device.go, and internal/protocol/sign/*.go for cross-checking.
https://github.com/beilunyang/openhongguo/tree/42b73f201309423f012d483bfc0ce579dcc0937c
Apache-2.0; full text retained as LICENSE.openhongguo.
Changes: Workers-compatible ESM/Buffer/node:crypto/node:zlib, pure JavaScript SM3,
explicit request builders with no fetch/FS/VM/eval/native executable dependency,
strict guest registration validation and 7.3.9.32 ordered anonymous requests.
The public upstream synthetic signature vectors are retained in protocol.test.mjs;
passing them validates arithmetic and request construction, not live availability.
This combined isolated service remains distributed under GPL-3.0-only. It must
not be linked or copied into the Den App target.
